notes.title: UI update!
notes.notes:
This update contains a facelift for the lobby shop, inventory and in-game interface to make it much sleeker and more in-keeping with the game's theme. 

We've also patched some bugs which include: 

Player's dying on the spikes in Hane's arena if they come within close proximity

3rd person camera causing glitching when you face directly up or down

Poison not affecting players or displaying in the poison indicator

notes.title: Another big update!
notes.notes:
Here is what our latest update includes:

Splash damage has now been fixed.

Spell pass-through has been fixed.

Phoenix now homes in correctly.

Trap deaths have been fixed.

Hane's arena has been upgraded to a larger, better looking map.

New 8 player map - Archeron Arena!

Camera now follows your ragdoll upon death.

Character page has been optimized to show level/exp easier.

notes.title: Our next big update is here!
notes.notes:
We have implemented 2 new maps:

Plague Town and Island Fortress

These maps will be for large scale battles (8-16) players. 

Due to their size we have given players speed increases on these levels to help naviagate them quicker. 

We have also added the option for 3rd person perspective by pressing V. 

Duel mode now has a 10 kill victory requirement instead of being time-based.

And lastly we have added sounds for walking on different types of ground, walking through water and falling a long distance.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Bot team fights are now functioning properly, you will no longer be set as an enemy of every AI player. 

Level not updating when the required exp amount is reached is now fixed.

 Ai will now react to player spell effects such as knockback on fireball and attract on black hole.
